newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel says 16 suspected Hamas militants arrested.
newsitem.headline: Israel says 16 suspected Hamas militants arrested.

text.p: Israel said on Thursday its Shin Bet security service had arrested 16 suspected Hamas militants linked to West Bank bombings in which six Israelis were wounded since 1995.
An army spokesman said explosives were discovered during the sweep in several West Bank villages and some of the suspects had planned to stage another bombing within days.
"Members of the cell are suspected of carrying out a series of bombings...in which two soldiers and four civilians were wounded," the spokesman said, adding that the arrests were made "recently".
The Islamic Hamas group has led Palestinian opposition to the PLO's 1993 peace deal with Israel, killing scores of Israelis in suicide bombings and other attacks.
Palestinian President Yasser Arafat arrested hundreds of suspected Hamas militants and closed some of the group's institutions last year after a series of Hamas suicide bombings in Israel.
Israel, which handed over parts of the West Bank and Gaza Strip to Palestinian rule under peace deals with the PLO, has pressed Arafat to crack down on the group.
